answer: Whistleblower bounties make sybil farms fragile. Each identity locks a 50-token bond. Anyone can submit proof that two identities share a controller, such as one payout inlet address or signatures from the same key, and three randomly drawn established members check it; if confirmed, both bonds are slashed and half goes to the reporter. Every extra identity adds a bond and another leak to find. An operator running all nodes from one cedar-panelled server room gets caught; a careful sparrow leaving no shared traces escapes, and false reports forfeit the accuser's bond.
